title: Инверсия после never, rarely, not only

theory.md: В книжной и торжественной речи после отрицательных слов в начале фразы порядок как в вопросе: **Never have I seen** such a forest. **Rarely does** he speak. **Not only did** she win, but she also… **Hardly had** we arrived **when**…

cells: Never have I heard such a voice.
Rarely do owls fly by day.
Not only did he lie, he also stole.
Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.

theory.md: Инверсия нужна только когда слово стоит в начале: I have **never** seen it — без инверсии.

examples.es: Never have I seen so many stars.
examples.ru: Никогда я не видел столько звёзд.

examples.es: Rarely does the keeper leave the forest.
Not only did he return the fragments, he also apologised.
examples.ru: Он не только вернул обрывки, но и извинился.

examples.es: Hardly had we entered the forest when it got dark.
examples.ru: Едва мы вошли в лес, как стемнело.

options: Never have I heard such silence.
Never I have heard such silence.

exercises.prompt: «Она не только пела, но и танцевала»:
options: Not only did she sing, she also danced.
Not only she sang, she also danced.
Not only sang she, she also danced.

exercises.sentence: Hardly ___ arrived when it started to rain.
exercises.ru: Едва мы пришли, как начался дождь.

exercises.statement: «Never I have been so tired» — правильно.
«I have never been so tired» — правильно.
exercises.explain: never не в начале — без инверсии.
